parts.text: I keep drones and charging equipment in working order by adding new drones, retiring old ones, and setting up charging pads at our sites. I also take drones out of service for repairs, put them back, and send them to charge. Repairs and servicing are carried out by me, and regulators can ask us to show how our drones have been looked after. I do not know what tasks we need this new service to handle, as I do not know anything about software.
